author: Linnaeus, 1758
summary: 우리나라에서는 부산에서 겨울에 한 마리가 채집된 기록만 있는 미조이다. 경작지, 덤불, 관목 숲 등에 산다. 나무나 덤불에 둥지를 틀고 5~6월에 회백색 바탕에 진한 점무늬가 있는 알을 4~6개 낳는다.

points.en: brown tail with white outer feathers

art.subject: Lesser Whitethroat (Sylvia curruca), adult (sexes alike), a wintering bird as recorded in Korea: crown and nape grey; lores and ear-coverts darker blackish-grey, forming a dark mask that contrasts with the paler grey crown; chin and throat pure white; back, scapulars and wings greyish-brown, without a rufous wing panel; breast and belly white with a faint buff wash on the breast sides and flanks; tail dark greyish-brown with white outer feathers; short, fine dark grey bill; dark grey legs.
art.pose: perched in a bush, side view
art.scene: Korean winter thicket and scrub at the edge of farmland; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched on a twig: grey crown with a darker grey mask through the eye, pure white throat, greyish-brown back and wings with no rufous panel, white belly, short dark bill, dark grey legs
adult, flight view seen squarely from above, head, body and tail in a line: greyish-brown back and wings, dark greyish-brown tail with white outer feathers
art.build: A small, neat warbler, 13cm, about sparrow length but slimmer, with a rounded head and a medium-length tail. Bill short, fine and pointed, clearly shorter than the head, dark grey. Legs medium, dark grey to blackish. Wings plain, with no wing-bars. Tail medium, square to slightly rounded, dark with white outer feathers that show when it flies or flicks the tail. Moves actively but keeps hidden in dense bushes.
avoid: Do not paint a rufous wing panel or pale legs; that is Common Whitethroat.
Do not paint a black cap ending at eye level (Blackcap); the crown is grey and the dark area is on the ear-coverts.
Do not paint the throat buff or streaked; it is pure white.
Do not paint a long or thick bill.
